overloads.semanticRole: The SET INDEX CACHE PRIORITY command sets a specific priority to the index(es) related to the aField in cache for all processes in the current session.

constraints: Only works in local mode (4D Server and 4D single-user); cannot be used in 4D remote mode.
Should be called in the On Startup or On Server Startup database method.
Applies to all indexes related to aField, including keyword indexes; composite index priorities cannot be customized separately.
